subject: Embeddings + Rerank onboarding: staging cutover & sync cadence
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>

Subject: Embeddings + Rerank onboarding: staging cutover & sync cadence

Alice —

Congrats again on choosing Redwood for the ACME product search upgrade. To keep momentum we should lock the onboarding plan and cutover windows this week. Below is a concise runbook proposal that balances a safe index backfill with a fast path to production rerank. Please confirm owners and the sample data delivery ETA.

High-level goals
- Complete index backfill of ~12M documents to the vector DB (staging) without impacting ACME's ingestion pipeline.
- Run rerank evaluation on a held-out query suite and reach our baseline relevance (Delta < 3% on MAP) before prod cutover.
- Have a tested rollback path and staged fallback to the legacy search endpoint.

Proposed timeline (week 0 = next Monday)
- Week 0 (kickoff): data handoff + manifest, initial vector DB sizing + staging cluster spin-up
- Week 1: seed-backfill 10% sample, run smoke inference & rerank evals, iterate prompts/thresholds
- Week 2: full backfill (staged batches with checkpointing), rerank A/B in staging, perf tuning (batching/kv cache)
- Week 3: canary cutover to 5% traffic, monitor quality and latency, expand to 100% if green

Key action items (owner : due)
- Data manifest + sample export (ACME : Alice) : 2027-05-31 EOD
- Vector DB choice & retention policy decision (ACME + Redwood) : 2027-06-02
- Test queries / eval set (ACME) : 2027-05-31
- Staging cluster sizing (Neha) : 2027-06-01
- Migration checklist & rollback steps (Marcus/Monica) : 2027-06-01

Technical constraints to confirm
- Preferred vector DB (hosted: Pinecone, managed Milvus, or self-hosted Elastic + plugin)
- Desired TTL / document retention and legal S3 bucket location for KV/cache snapshot
- SLA for canary (max p95 latency increase tolerated)

Attachments: acme_sample_docs.csv (rows sample), redwood_migration_checklist.md (runbook stub)

Can we schedule a 30-min kickoff tomorrow? I propose 10:00am PT — if that works I will send a calendar invite and include the staging playbook.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Thanks — great to see the timelines aligned. A few operational notes & checklist items from CS that make cutover smoother:

Operational playbook (short)
- Transfer methods: s3 presigned uploads OR secure SFTP. For >1M rows we recommend multipart S3.
- Staging access: we'll create a short-lived staging API key and scoped role for ACME to upload and validate vectors.
- Monitoring: set up a per-route dashboard (tokens, latency, error rate) and a simple PagerDuty play for critical regressions during canary.
- Eval gating: we gate on both a relevance threshold (MAP) and an allowed latency delta at p95. Both must be green to proceed.

Accepting the managed Milvus option for staging is fine — Redwood supports a managed connector and will operator-check the cluster. For long-term production we should evaluate cost/replication tradeoffs; we'll draft a short pros/cons doc.

Kickoff: 10:00am PT tomorrow works. Marcus — please send the invite and include the quick checklist below in the calendar description:
- Upload data manifest link
- Test queries doc
- Contact matrix (ACME infra, ACME product, Redwood eng, Redwood CS)

Monica Patel

Looping in some engineering specifics from the runtime team so ACME can size accordingly. Key points below — these will be part of the technical runbook I will drop in the Drive folder after kickoff.

Backfill and throughput
- For a 12M doc backfill we recommend staged batching at ~200k docs per job with parallelism of 4 workers per job. That yields ~800k docs / hour write throughput to managed Milvus under baseline network conditions. If ACME needs faster ingestion we can increase workers or provision a transient ingest node (we will need upload bandwidth numbers).
- Recommended vectorization: model-v1.3 (quantized int8 in staging) — reduces memory footprint, minimal quality delta vs fp16.

Rerank eval and smoke testing
- Eval set: 2,000 queries with graded relevance buckets (ACME to provide). We'll run baseline metrics (MAP, NDCG@10) and a statistical significance test.
- Canary config: 5% traffic on rerank model with logging (store request/response ids in S3 for quick rollbacks).

Rollback & fallback
- Fallback: legacy search endpoint via header switch. We'll implement an automated rollout monitor that flips to legacy if MAP drops >5% or p95 latency increases >60%.

Questions for ACME (please provide)
- Expected sustained qps for search (90th percentile during peak hour)
- Maximum window for scheduled tariff-free maintenance for staging cluster

I will publish a technical checklist (JSON + markdown) to the drive after the call.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Principal Infra Engineer — Redwood Inference
